Self-hosted web fonts for the Editions covers. All are SIL Open Font License 1.1
(https://openfontlicense.org). The page's UI face, which the covers also use as NJ Text (fronts at
800/900, back labels at 400/600), is documented in ui/SOURCE.txt.

Each file below is a Google Fonts text= subset of one static instance: it holds exactly the glyphs the
covers draw in that face, no more. All were downloaded 2026-11-03 from fonts.gstatic.com through the
css2 request shown (text= value URL-encoded). The back faces' sets come from the strings in the tracked
editions/data/projects.json.

Regenerating: when a title, a back-cover name or figure, a stack line or the About headline changes,
recompute the face's glyph set from editions/data/projects.json (sorted unique characters of the
strings listed for it), request css2?family=<axes as shown>&text=<set>, take the single url(...) in the
response, and replace the file. A character outside its face's set renders in a fallback font.

fraunces-144pt-bold-cover.woff2 — NJ Serif, the Stellar Explorer title and the About back's headline
  Fraunces (Undercase Type), gstatic v38, opsz 144 · wght 700 · SOFT 0 · WONK 0
  glyphs: " ,.EHINSaeilmoprtx’" (from "Stellar Explorer" and about[0], "Hi, I’m Neil.")
  css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght,SOFT,WONK@144,700,0,0&text=%20%2C.EHINSaeilmoprtx%E2%80%99
  3 032 bytes, sha256 5fb7f377b44dc7bc16204cce8ec513f0958473a35ade6e14459f093f98db6a54
  Licence: OFL-1.1 (https://github.com/undercasetype/Fraunces)

hanken-grotesk-600-cover.woff2 — NJ Hanken, the Topshine wordmark (600, each letter placed on its concept letter)
  Hanken Grotesk (The Hanken Grotesk Project Authors), gstatic v12, wght 600
  glyphs: "ehinopst" (from "topshine")
  css2?family=Hanken%20Grotesk:wght@600&text=ehinopst
  1 440 bytes, sha256 ad152b3c0e603c9a73fac8adeb76d13393edc11bbbcc5f92fe0dd4c1d3095f64
  Licence: OFL-1.1 (https://github.com/marcologous/hanken-grotesk); the same family Topshine vendors
  in ~/dev/topshine-design-waitlist/engine/assets/fonts/. Chosen by fitting 57 OFL candidates (Hanken Grotesk at
  600 to 800, Red Hat Display, Manrope, Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, Figtree and others) to the concept's letter masks;
  it fit best with Red Hat Display 700 (IoU 0.93), every letter box within 0.2% of the cover.

bricolage-grotesque-96pt-extrabold-title-cover.woff2 — NJ Bricolage, the Stats title (800, set at −0.01em)
  Bricolage Grotesque (Mathieu Triay), gstatic v9, opsz 96 · wdth 100 · wght 800
  glyphs: "Sast" (from "Stats")
  css2?family=Bricolage%20Grotesque:opsz,wdth,wght@96,100,800&text=Sast
  1 364 bytes, sha256 b644e3cd2a00fd6a11d0e887e30caa783f4a918020d29b1f0d40b3a0cc92c228
  Licence: OFL-1.1 (https://github.com/ateliertriay/bricolage); stats.njct.io sets "Stats" at 700, the
  cover at 800 to match the heavier concept

bricolage-grotesque-96pt-extrabold-cover.woff2 — NJ Display, back covers: names and figure values
  Bricolage Grotesque (Mathieu Triay), gstatic v9, opsz 96 · wdth 100 · wght 800
  glyphs: all printable ASCII (U+20–7E) and ’‘“”–—·→×£€… (2026-11-04: the figures change often, so the
  face holds every character they may use rather than the current strings alone; "Up to 85%" needed U and 8)
  css2?family=Bricolage%20Grotesque:opsz,wdth,wght@96,100,800&text=<those characters, URL-encoded>
  16 152 bytes, sha256 61f8428c49eb2eaa61db5dc1c9e779110d8884038ae465b6ae2c6040fd55c02a

jetbrains-mono-medium-cover.woff2 — NJ Mono, back covers: the stack line
  JetBrains Mono (JetBrains), gstatic v24, wght 500
  glyphs: " .02359ABCDEFGHIKLMNOPQRSTUVWXabcdefghijklmnoprstuwxy·" (every stack value)
  css2?family=JetBrains%20Mono:wght@500&text=%20.02359ABCDEFGHIKLMNOPQRSTUVWXabcdefghijklmnoprstuwxy%C2%B7
  3 684 bytes, sha256 b5669e1fd093231b17d55c0583a27371fc1689231fbf1eef3d25d237316aa17c

The fronts load the first four with the UI face; the last two load with the first back.
